## Methods

### ResolveHostname

Resolves a hostname to one or more IP addresses.

```go
func (c *Client) ResolveHostname(ctx context.Context, in ResolveHostnameIn) (*ResolveHostnameOut, error)
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | The Linux interface index for the network interface to search on. Typically left unspecified, in order to search on all interfaces. |
| `name` | `string` | The host name to resolve. |
| `family` | `?int` | The address family to search for, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. |
| `flags` | `?int` | Various search flags. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addresses` | `[]ResolvedAddress` | Array of resolved IP addresses |
| `name` | `string` | Canonical name of the host. |
| `flags` | `int` | Various flags indicating details on discovered data. |

### BrowseServices

:material-waves: streaming (requires `more`) · :material-new-box: since v258

Starts browsing for DNS-SD services of specified type.

```go
func (c *Client) BrowseServices(ctx context.Context, in BrowseServicesIn) iter.Seq2[*BrowseServicesOut, error]
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `domain` | `?string` | The domain to browse for services. If null, the default browsing domain local is used. |
| `type` | `?string` | The service type to browse for (e.g., '_http._tcp'). |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | The Linux interface index for the network interface to search on. |
| `flags` | `?int` | Various browsing flags to modify the operation. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `browserServiceData` | `[]ServiceData` | An array of service data containing information about discovered services. |

## Types

### DNSProtocol

The type of protocol.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `dns` | DNS |
| `mdns` | Multicast DNS |
| `llmnr` | LLMNR |

### DNSOverTLSMode

The mode of DNSOverTLS.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `no` | DNSOverTLS is disabled. |
| `yes` | DNSOverTLS is enabled. |
| `opportunistic` | Try to use DNSOverTLS, but disabled when the server does not support it. |

### ResolveSupport

Whether the protocol is enabled.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `no` | The protocol is disabled. |
| `yes` | The protocol is enabled. |
| `resolve` | The protocol is used only for resolving. |

### ResolvConfMode

The management mode of /etc/resolve.conf file.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `uplink` | /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf. |
| `stub` | /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf. |
| `static` | /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /usr/lib/systemd/resolv.conf. |
| `missing` | /etc/resolv.conf does not exist. |
| `foreign` | /etc/resolv.conf is not managed by systemd-resolved. |

### BrowseServiceUpdateFlag

Describes the update flag for browsing services, indicating whether a service was added or removed during browsing.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `added` | Indicates that the service was added. |
| `removed` | Indicates that the service was removed. |

### ResolvedCanonical

Encapsulates the canonical name, type and domain of a DNS-SD or simple SRV service. Note that due to CNAME redirections and similar, a named DNS-SD service might resolve to a canonical service that is an unnamed simple SRV service. Or in other words: resolving a named service might return an unnamed canonical service.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `?string` | The DNS-SD name of the service. For simple SRV services this field is absent or null. |
| `type` | `string` |  |
| `domain` | `string` |  |

### ResourceKey

The 'key' part of a DNS resource record.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | `?int` | The RR class, almost always IN, i.e 0x01. If unspecified defaults to IN. |
| `type` | `int` | The RR types, one of A, AAAA, PTR, … |
| `name` | `string` | The domain name. |

### DNSConfiguration

Encapsulates a global or per-link DNS configuration, including configured DNS servers, search domains, and more.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ifname` | `?string` | Interface name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | Interface index, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. |
| `delegate` | `?string` | Delegate name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global or link configurations. |
| `defaultRoute` | `?bool` | Indicates whether or not this link's DNS servers will be used for resolving domain names that do not match any link's configured domains. |
| `currentServer` | `?DNSServer` | DNS server currently selected to use for lookups. |
| `servers` | `?[]DNSServer` | Array of configured DNS servers. |
| `fallbackServers` | `?[]DNSServer` | Array of configured fallback DNS servers, set for global configuration only. |
| `searchDomains` | `?[]SearchDomain` | Array of configured search domains. |
| `negativeTrustAnchors` | `?[]string` | Array of configured DNSSEC negative trust anchors. |
| `dnssec` | `?string` | DNSSEC mode. |
| `dnssecSupported` | `?bool` | Indicates if the current DNS server supports DNSSEC. Always false if DNSSEC mode is "no". |
| `dnsOverTLS` | `?DNSOverTLSMode` | DNSOverTLS mode. |
| `llmnr` | `?string` | LLMNR support. |
| `mDNS` | `?ResolveSupport` | mDNS support. |
| `resolvConfMode` | `?ResolvConfMode` | resolv.conf mode, set for global configuration only. |
| `scopes` | `?[]DNSScope` | Array of current DNS scopes. |
